exposure: double balloon catheter combined with oxytocin
outcome: Time between induction of labor and delivery (TID)
cohort: 80 patients undergoing labor induction for premature rupture of membranes at term with an unfavorable cervix
finding: The study found no significant difference in time to delivery between double balloon catheter with oxytocin and dinoprostone insert for labor induction, except in nulliparous women where the catheter group had a shorter time to delivery.
mod_finding: The rate of vaginal delivery within 24 hours was significantly higher in the combined induction group (double balloon catheter with oxytocin).
